metadata.title: When you accidentally click and Valorant says ‘Here, have a kill?’ LOL what even?!
metadata.description:
Wait, I didn’t even try!
One lucky shot and enemy vanished like magic.
Click if your aim ghosts you but kills still happen!
Valorant logic making me question life again.

Tap if your kills are pure accident gold!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
metadata.cta: Tap if your kills are pure accident gold!
